confirm.title: Delete your account?
confirm.description: This permanently deletes the account {{email}}. Your personal data will be anonymized, you will be signed out and you can no longer sign in. This cannot be undone.

success.title: Account deleted
success.message: Your account has been deleted and can no longer be used to sign in.

apiErrors.DeleteAccountTokenInvalidException: The confirmation link is invalid or already used.
apiErrors.DeleteAccountTokenExpiredException: The confirmation link has expired. Please request a new one.
apiErrors.UserHasActiveUsageSessions: Your account still has active usage sessions. End them before deleting your account.
apiErrors.unexpectedError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
